backend.command:
python3 -c "import sys; from pathlib import Path; from mod_editor.core import nfl2k5_abilities_runtime as m; result, receipt = m.apply(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes())
with Path(sys.argv[2]).open('xb') as output:
    output.write(result)
print(receipt)" <source.xbe> <new-copy.xbe>

gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. Explicit opt-in; new switches off in all presets. Protected Build/Gameplay integration is in WIRING.md.

input_constraints: Pinned USA XBE with supported composed owners; foreign/mixed bytes and settings refuse.
Reserve the complete allocator owner union first. Seven shipped roster flags; no automatic assignment or save migration.
abilities_off_week is None or integer zero-based regular-season row 0..17. All presets off.
The special-move meter is restricted to live ball carriers. Right-stick actions also require Right-Stick Moves; unclassified charge consumers are denied.
portme: Complete Noah's witness list in ASTRA_ABILITIES_RUNTIME_REPORT.md, including noncarrier meter impact and all controller layouts.

public_distribution.rule: Ship source and recipes; never distribute the generated game executable or disc.

runtime.scope: Bounded native clamps, command gates, initializer and native meter only. No game, loader, save-lifecycle or simulated-game witness.

fields.name: abilities
fields.allowed: false by default in Basic, Advanced and Experimental; explicit opt-in

fields.name: abilities_off_week
fields.allowed: None or integer 0..17; meaningful only with abilities enabled

selectors.notes: Week displayed 1..18 maps to zero-based 0..17. Existing week only; simulation unaffected.

source_container.resource: seven pinned hook spans and a named 1072-byte immutable RX allocation; zero new writable state
source_container.retail_file: user-owned default.xbe in an NFL 2K5 USA disc

summary: Stored player permissions control movement Speed, special moves and native charge; one optional existing regular-season week disables them.
